# DOMINASE

DOMINASE is a software and digital product company based in Amman, Jordan, serving clients in Jordan and Saudi Arabia.
Positioning: Software & Digital Products — Make it simple.

## What DOMINASE builds
- Company and product websites with conversion-focused UX and technical SEO foundations
- Custom business systems, admin dashboards, workflows, CRM and operational tools
- Education platforms for instructors and academies
- Clinic websites, booking journeys, campaign-specific CTAs, tracking and follow-up systems
- UX/UI and digital product experiences in Arabic and English

## Editorial topics
DOMINASE publishes practical material about SEO and discoverability, CTA design, websites as systems, customer behavior, analytics/pixels, booking, CRM, UX, and the operational layer behind digital products.

## Market and language
Primary market context: Jordan and Saudi Arabia.
Primary Arabic style: clear modern business Arabic suitable for both markets, with English content available in the interface.
